text: [25] nayidaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhanatthaṃ na janalapanatthaṃ na lābhasakkārasilokānisaṃsatthaṃ na itivādappamokkhānisaṃsatthaṃ na iti maṃ jano jānātūti athakho idaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati saṃvaratthaṃ pahānatthaṃ virāgatthaṃ nirodhatthanti . saṃvaratthaṃ pahānatthaṃ brahmacariyaṃ anītihaṃ adesayi so bhagavā nibbānogadhagāminaṃ esa maggo mahantehi anuyāto mahesibhi . ye ca taṃ paṭipajjanti yathā buddhena desitaṃ dukkhassantaṃ karissanti satthusāsanakārinoti .
